title: Level it. Open its wings.
alt: An astronaut kneels beside the seismic instrument with its two solar panels open. A large circular inset magnifies the leveling bubble on the instrument.
context: Deployment included positioning and leveling the instrument and opening its solar panels. The inset magnifies the setup principle rather than showing a measured level reading.
interpretation: Original story illustration. Viewpoint, lighting, pose, geometry and apparent distances are interpretive. Scientific arrows, waves, cutaways and displays explain principles; they are not recorded telemetry, a literal instrument diagram or a historical photograph.

sources.label: NASA · The seismometer detects the crew’s footsteps
